lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to go to the promised land, but says He will not go with them.
When the people hear the bad news, they mourn, and the Israelites strip off their jewelry from Mount Sinai onward.
The LORD speaks with Moses face to face at the Tent of Meeting, and Caleb stays there when Moses returns.
Moses says not to lead them up without God's Presence, and the LORD agrees because Moses found favor.
Moses asks to see God's glory, but the LORD says no one can see His face and live.
